title: Precipitation behavior and mechanical properties of a hot-worked TiNbTa0.5ZrAl0.5 refractory high entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by blending elemental powders (Ti, Nb, Ta, Zr, Al) with a high efficiency blender for 10 h under argon atmosphere, compacted via cold isostatic pressing at 200 MPa, sintered at 1300 °C for 16 h under vacuum of 1 × 10⁻³ Pa followed by furnace cooling, then hot forged at 1200 °C with a total height reduction of 50% followed by furnace cooling
